title: Agentic App Tester
brief: An agentic mobile UI tester that converts natural-language test steps into actions

descriptor.detail: Implemented an agentic regression testing system that translates NL test steps into validated UI actions, captures in-progress screenshots for CV-based state verification, and produces detailed regression reports measuring flakiness and time-to-detect.

one.descriptor: Used a modular MLLM to map free-form test steps into typed action schemas. Schemas are validated with Pydantic to prevent invalid interactions and reduce test failures caused by malformed actions.

two.header: End-to-end testing pipeline with CV verification
two.descriptor: Designed a pipeline that captures screenshots during execution and feeds them into a CV system using OpenCV for image-difference detection and state validation to confirm successful UI transitions.
